format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this character, like "hero". It matches the file name.

body.description: "dynamic" moves and falls; "fixed" stays where it is put.

w.description: How wide the character is, in tiles.

h.description: How tall the character is, in tiles.

size.description: The size of the character, in tiles.

color.description: The colour it is drawn in, as # and six digits, like #e4572e.

upright.description: True if the character stays on its feet and cannot be tipped over. Left out means false.

kind.description: What this is to the game's rules and to behaviour files, like "crate", "spark" or "door".

figure.description: The figure it is drawn from, by id, like "hero". Left out means the coloured box.

id.description: A name for this clip, used once in this character, like "run".

poses.description: The poses of the character's figure it shows, in order, by id, like ["run-1", "run-2"].

fps.description: How many pictures a second it shows, from 1 to 60.

loop.description: True to go round again at the end, false to hold the last picture.

clips.description: The ways it moves, as runs of its figure's poses. "idle", "run", "jump", "fall" and "land" play by how it moves; any other, like "push" or "talk", plays when the game or a cutscene asks. Left out means the first pose.

behaviour.description: The behaviour file that decides what it does, by id, like "critter".

tuning.description: The tuning file whose numbers decide how it moves, by id, like "hero".

touch.description: "sense": things pass through it and the game is told when one touches it, like a door. "take": the same, and it is taken away when a hero touches it, like a spark.
